faqs.q: How much does a professional website cost with AK Digital Studio in Surat?
faqs.a: Our transparent packages begin at ₹4,999 for a 5-page Starter Website, ₹9,999 for a Standard Catalogue with up to 20 products, ₹14,999 for a Premium Website with up to 50 products and checkout, and ₹24,999 for a full E-commerce Solution with 1-year client support. There are zero hidden agency charges or recurring lock-in contracts.

faqs.q: What is the typical delivery timeline for completing a website?
faqs.a: Delivery turnaround depends on the chosen package: Starter Websites are delivered within 3 days; Standard Catalogues take 3 to 5 days; Premium Websites take 5 to 7 days; and full E-commerce Stores are ready in 7 to 14 days, provided all content and images are supplied.

faqs.q: Are domain registration and web hosting included in the plans?
faqs.a: Domain registration and web hosting fees are separate to guarantee you retain 100% legal ownership of your digital assets. We directly assist you in selecting and configuring high-speed, cost-effective hosting (Hostinger, MilesWeb, or Cloudflare Pages) in your name.

faqs.q: What kind of ongoing support is included after my website is launched?
faqs.a: Every website built by AK Digital Studio includes 1 full year of basic setup support and maintenance. This covers bug fixes, minor content tweaks, DNS management, and technical troubleshooting directly with Lead Developer Aatif Kureshi.

faqs.q: Will my website appear on Google Maps and Google Search results in Surat?
faqs.a: Yes! All our websites are engineered with technical on-page SEO, mobile responsiveness, fast loading speed, and schema.org LocalBusiness structured data. We also configure or optimize your Google Business Profile to help you rank in the Surat Google 3-Pack.

faqs.q: Can I easily update product pictures, descriptions, and prices on my own?
faqs.a: Absolutely. For catalogue and e-commerce websites, we provide an intuitive admin management area and include a 1-on-1 walkthrough session showing you how to add, edit, or remove products and prices without needing any coding skills.

faqs.q: Do you provide direct WhatsApp click-to-chat integration on every page?
faqs.a: Yes. In the Indian market, WhatsApp is the number one lead conversion channel. Every plan comes with customizable WhatsApp click-to-chat buttons with pre-filled product or inquiry inquiry messages that initiate instant conversations.

faqs.q: Will my website work properly on mobile phones and tablets?
faqs.a: 100%. Every single layout is developed with a strict mobile-first design system and rigorously tested across real iOS and Android devices, laptops, and 4K displays to ensure perfect typography, fluid images, and easy touch navigation.

faqs.q: What payment gateways can be integrated for online transactions in India?
faqs.a: We integrate top Indian payment gateways including Razorpay, Cashfree, and PhonePe PG, supporting UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), debit/credit cards, and net banking with zero setup hassles.

faqs.q: How do I get started with AK Digital Studio for my project?
faqs.a: Simply click 'Get a quote' or contact Lead Developer Aatif Kureshi directly via WhatsApp at +91 76984 50003 or email AKdigitalstudio.org@gmail.com. We will review your goals and provide a written roadmap and quote within 24 hours.
